postconditions.description: The output contains exactly 4 - n + 1 lines.
The first line of output is either 'YES' or 'NO'.
If the first line is 'YES', then there are exactly 4 - n more lines of output.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(b) <= 10**6 for b in output[1:])
postconditions.description: All the numbers b in the output are between 1 and 10^6, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(a_i <= b <= 10**6 for a_i in input_boxes for b in output[1:])
postconditions.description: All the numbers b are greater than or equal to all the given numbers a_i.

postconditions.expression: all(mean(input_boxes + output[1:]) == median(sorted(input_boxes + output[1:])) == range(max(input_boxes + output[1:]), min(input_boxes + output[1:]) - 1, -1) for input_boxes in all_possible_inputs)
postconditions.description: The mean, median, and range of the numbers are all equal.
